summary: Equinor ASA furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, containing a press release detailing purchases under the fourth tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme (the US-equivalent open-market repurchase authorization, announced October 28, 2026, running October 29, 2026 to no later than February 1, 2027). During October 29–30, 2026, the company bought 265,300 own shares at a weighted average of NOK 441.0372, total value NOK 117,007.167.13. Following settlement, Equinor holds 23,861,117 treasury shares, 1.00% of share capital (0.53% excluding share-savings-plan shares). Watch cumulative tranche progress and buyback pace.
